questions.question: The average age of a company A of 5 members is 44.8 years and the average age of another company B of 4 members is 48 years. By what percentage is the total age of company B less than the total age of company A?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average age of a company A of 5 members is 44.8 years

The average age of another company B of 4 members is 48 years.

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of Entities

Calculation:

Total age of Company A = 44.8 × 5 = 224 years

Total age of Company B = 48 × 4 = 192 years

Total age of company B is less than the total age of company A

⇒ frac {224 - 192}{224} times 100\% = frac {100}{7}\%

**∴ The total age of company B is less than the total age of company A by frac {100}{7}\%.**

questions.question: The product of two numbers is 19440 and their HCF is 18. The possible number of pairs of such numbers is:
questions.solution:
Given:

The product of two numbers is 19440 and their HCF is 18

Concept used:

If P is the HCF of A and B then

A = (P × m) & B = (P × n)

Where m and n are arbitrary positive integers and co-prime to each other.

Calculation:

Let the two numbers be 18a and 18b respectively

According to the question,

18a × 18b = 19440

⇒ ab = 19440/324

⇒ ab = 60

Possible pairs of a and b = (1, 60), (3, 20), (4,15), (5, 12)

**∴ The possible number of pairs of such numbers is 4.**

questions.question: The marked price of an article is ₹850. If a shopkeeper sold the article at 15% loss after giving 30% discount, then the cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

(MP)/(CP) = (100-Loss)/(100-Doscount) = (100-15)/(100-30) = (85)/(70)

MP = ₹850 → 85 units = ₹850 → 1 unit = ₹10

Thus, CP = 70 × 10 = ₹700

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The marked price of an article is ₹850

Article is sold at 15% loss after giving a 30% discount

Concept used:

SP = MP × ((100-Discount)/(100))

SP = CP × ((100-Loss)/(100))

Calculation:

SP = 850 × (100-30)/(100) = 850 × (70)/(100) = Rs 595

CP = 595 × (100)/(100-15) = 595 × (100)/(85) = Rs 700

∴ The CP of the article is Rs 700.

questions.question: 5 men and 3 women can earn ₹8,400 in 4 days. 9 men and 7 women can earn ₹28,700 in 7 days. In how many days will 8 men and 5 women earn ₹30,600?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
1 day earning of 5M + 3W = 8400 ÷ 4 = ₹2100 ... (i)

1 day earning of 9M + 7W = 28700 ÷ 7 = ₹4100 ... (ii)

Solve (i) × 7 − (ii) × 3: (35M + 21W) − (27M + 21W) = 14700 − 12300

8M = 2400 ⇒ M = ₹300, and substituting M gives W = ₹200.

Daily earning of 8M + 5W = 8(300) + 5(200) = ₹3400.

Total days to earn ₹30600 = 30600 ÷ 3400 = 9 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Earning of 5 men and 3 women in 4 days = ₹8,400

Earning of 9 men and 7 women in 7 days = ₹28,700

**Calculations:**

Let the daily earning of 1 man be M and 1 woman be W.

⇒ (5M + 3W) × 4 = 8400

⇒ 5M + 3W = 2100 ---- (Equation 1)

⇒ (9M + 7W) × 7 = 28700

⇒ 9M + 7W = 4100 ---- (Equation 2)

Multiplying Equation 1 by 7 and Equation 2 by 3:

⇒ 35M + 21W = 14700 ---- (Equation 3)

⇒ 27M + 21W = 12300 ---- (Equation 4)

Subtracting Equation 4 from Equation 3:

⇒ 35M − 27M = 14700 − 12300

⇒ 8M = 2400

⇒ M = 300

Substitute M = 300 in Equation 1:

⇒ 5(300) + 3W = 2100

⇒ 1500 + 3W = 2100

⇒ 3W = 600

⇒ W = 200

Calculate the daily earning of 8 men and 5 women:

⇒ 8M + 5W = 8(300) + 5(200)

⇒ Total daily earning = 2400 + 1000 = ₹3400

Number of days required to earn ₹30,600:

⇒ Required Days = Total Target Earning ÷ Daily Earning

⇒ Required Days = 30600 ÷ 3400 = 9 days

**∴ The correct answer is 9 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work & Wages Rule

Wages are distributed in direct proportion to the work done by individuals. When individuals work for the same number of days, their total wages are shared in the ratio of their daily efficiencies or one-day earnings.

Simultaneous Linear Equations

For a system of two variables, equations can be solved by scaling one or both equations to equalize the coefficients of one variable, then adding or subtracting to eliminate it and solve for the remaining unknown.

Unitary Method Application

The fastest way to equate different groups working for different time periods is to calculate the earnings or work done for exactly 1 unit of time (1 day) to establish a common proportional base.

questions.question: In a school, the total students (boys and girls only) are 720. Boys and girls are in the ratio 7 : 5. In another school, there are 560 students (boys and girls only) and the ratio of boys and girls is 3 : 5. The ratio of boys and girls in the total strength of the two schools is:
questions.solution:
Given:

In a school, the total students (boys and girls only) are 720. Boys and girls are in the ratio 7 : 5. In another school, there are 560 students (boys and girls only) and the ratio of boys and girls is 3 : 5. 

Calculation:

Number of boys in the first school = 720 × 7/(7 + 5) = 420

Number of girls in the first school = 720 × 5/(7 + 5) = 300

Number of boys in the second school = 560 × 3/(3 + 5) = 210

Number of girls in the second school = 560 × 5/(3 + 5) = 350

Now, The ratio of boys and girls in the total strength of the two schools

⇒ (420 + 210) : (300 + 350)

⇒ 630 : 650

⇒ 63 : 65

**∴ The ratio of boys and girls in the total strength of the two schools is 63 : 65.**

questions.question: A machine depreciates by 10% per year. The present worth of the machine is ₹2,50,000. After 2 years the value of the machine will be:

By successive method

Value after 2 years = 250000 × (90)/(100) × (90)/(100) = ₹2,02,500

A machine depreciates by 10% per year

The present worth of the machine is ₹2,50,000

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate of Interest, N = Time in years

Calculation:

After 2 years the value of the machine will be

⇒ 250000(1 - 10/100)²

(Here, the depreciation is considered as negative growth)

⇒ 250000 × 0.81

⇒ ₹2,02,500

**∴ After 2 years the value of the machine will be ₹2,02,500.**

questions.question: A man completes a journey in 12 h. He travels the first half of the journey at a speed of 21 km/h and the second half at a speed of 24 km/h. Find the total distance of the journey (in km).
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average speed for two equal halves of a journey = (2 × S₁ × S₂) ÷ (S₁ + S₂)

Average speed = (2 × 21 × 24) ÷ (21 + 24) = 1008 ÷ 45 = 22.4 km/h

Total Distance = Average Speed × Total Time

Total Distance = 22.4 × 12 = 268.8 km

**∴ The correct answer is 268.8 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed for first half (S₁) = 21 km/h

Speed for second half (S₂) = 24 km/h

Total time (T) = 12 hours

**Formula Used:**

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/edacaefe90deff5bceebe8f793d2412702537f6945bada6f16a8334776343fde.png] 

Let the total distance be D km.

⇒ Time for first half = (D ÷ 2) ÷ 21 = D ÷ 42 hours

⇒ Time for second half = (D ÷ 2) ÷ 24 = D ÷ 48 hours

⇒ Total Time = D ÷ 42 + D ÷ 48 = 12

⇒ (8D + 7D) ÷ 336 = 12 [LCM of 42 and 48 is 336]

⇒ 15D ÷ 336 = 12

⇒ 15D = 12 × 336

⇒ 15D = 4032

⇒ D = 4032 ÷ 15

⇒ D = 268.8 km

**∴ The correct answer is 268.8 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

It is the total distance traveled divided by the total time taken. Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time.

Conversion of Units

To convert km/h to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18/5.

Proportionality Rule

If distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (S ∝ 1/T). If time is constant, distance is directly proportional to speed (D ∝ S).</p

questions.question: The ratio of two numbers is 3 : 5 and their HCF is 6. Find their LCM.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Shortcut: LCM = HCF × Product of Ratio Parts

Ratio = 3 : 5 and HCF = 6

∴ LCM = 6 × (3 × 5)

∴ LCM = 6 × 15 = 90

**∴ The correct answer is 90.**

**__Alternate Method__**

Given: Ratio of two numbers = 3 : 5 and HCF = 6

Formula Used: Number = HCF × Ratio Part

 
 Ratio: 3
 
 Ratio: 5
 HCF Multiplier = 6
 

 Num 1 = 3 × 6 = 18
 

 Num 2 = 5 × 6 = 30
 LCM(18, 30) = 90

⇒ Let the two numbers be 3x and 5x.

⇒ The HCF of 3x and 5x is x (since 3 and 5 are co-prime).

⇒ Given HCF = 6, so x = 6.

⇒ First number = 3 × 6 = 18

⇒ Second number = 5 × 6 = 30

⇒ LCM of 18 and 30:

⇒ 18 = 2 × 3 × 3

⇒ 30 = 2 × 3 × 5

⇒ LCM = 2 × 3 × 3 × 5 = 90

**∴ The correct answer is 90.**

**__Additional Information__**

Fundamental Relation

For any two numbers A and B, Product of numbers = HCF × LCM. ⇒ A × B = HCF(A, B) × LCM(A, B).

LCM of Fractions

LCM of (a/b, c/d) = LCM(a, c) ÷ HCF(b, d).

Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers are co-prime, their HCF is always 1 and their LCM is always their product.

Property of Ratio

If the ratio of two numbers is a : b and their HCF is H, the numbers are Ha and Hb, and their LCM is H × a × b.</p

questions.question: A, B and C individually can complete a work in 12, 10 and 15 days, respectively. All three work together and after 3 days, B and C leave the work. The remaining work will be completed by A in:
questions.solution:
Given:

A, B and C individually can complete a work in 12, 10 and 15 days respectively

All three work together and after 3 days, B and C leave the work.

Concept used:

Total work = Efficiency × Total Time

Calculation:

LCM (12, 10, 15) = 60

Let the total work be 60 units (∵ LCM of 12, 10, 15 = 60)

Efficiency of A = 60/12 = 5 units/day

Efficiency of B = 60/10 = 6 units/day

Efficiency of C = 60/15 = 4 units/day

Work done in 3 days by A, B, C = 3 × (5 + 6 + 4) = 45 units

Time required by A to complete the remaining work

⇒ (60 - 45)/5 = 3 days

**∴ The remaining work will be completed by A in 3 days.**

questions.question: A certain sum becomes double in 2 years at a certain rate per annum compound interest. The number of years it will become 4 times at the same compound interest rate is:
questions.solution:
Given:

A certain sum becomes double in 2 years at a certain rate per annum compound interest.

Concept used:

In case of the compound interest,

Amount = P(1 + R/100)N

CI = P(1 + R/100)N - P

Where, P = Principal, R = Rate of Interest, N = Time in years

Calculation:

Let the rate of interest and principal be R% and P respectively

According to the question,

P(1 + R/100)² = 2P

⇒ (1 + R/100)2 = 2

⇒ (1 + R/100)4 = 2² (Squaring both sides)

⇒ P(1 + R/100)4 = 22 × P (Multiplying P on both sides)

⇒ P(1 + R/100)4 = 4 × P ....(1)

Now, from (1), we can clearly conclude in 4 years the principal will become 4 times in amount at the same rate of interest.

**∴ The number of years it will become 4 times at the same compound interest rate is 4 years.**

questions.question: The length and breadth of a rectangular field are in the ratio 4 : 3. If the cost of cultivating the field at ₹2 per m² is ₹600, then the length of the field is:

⇒ x = 5 (considering the positive value only)

Now, the length of the field = 4 × 5 = 20m

questions.question: Two positive numbers are in the ratio 5 : 8. If the sum of their squares is 356, then the sum of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
Given:

Two positive numbers are in the ratio 5 : 8.

The sum of their squares is 356.

Calculation:

Let the positive numbers be 5x and 8x respectively

Sum of these numbers = 5x + 8x = 13x

According to the question,

(5x)² + (8x)² = 356

⇒ 25x² + 64x² = 356

⇒ 89x² = 356

⇒ x² = 356/89

⇒ x² = 4

⇒ x = +2 (∵ given numbers are positive only)

⇒ 13x = 26

∴ The sum of those two numbers is 26.
